Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Neem oil 5 ml/L; remove infected leaves; avoid overhead watering
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.advice: Remove badly infected leaves first. Do not work in the field when plants are wet. Streptocycline is used at a very low dose (about 0.1 g/L); follow the label.

Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Trichoderma or neem oil 5 ml/L; remove lower infected leaves
